sections.heading: Value copies and identity boundaries
sections.markdown: `const` fixes the binding and its value-semantic components. Saving a copyable Array into another binding preserves a logical copy; it does not require explicit copy/move or unique backing. Class and synchronized fields retain identity, so const does not freeze their referenced objects or prove Sendable. Type-position `const T` is outside this frozen subset. The example states the language contract, not complete new-XIR implementation qualification.
